shared_elements: low-relief animal figures carved on a flat pillar face
elongated serpentine or curving line motif
abstract angular/geometric sign (e.g. H- or L-shaped element)
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief animals in profile accompanied by an abstract angular sign and long curving/serpentine lines on the flat face of a pillar, and both use the same flat, schematic outline-relief convention. However, A shows a single sparse creature with a bare curving line on an otherwise empty field, whereas B is densely packed and register-organised, with a row of frontal beast heads and hanging discs at the top, a band of repeated hatch marks, and stacked panels of birds, a serpent-like figure and other animals, so the compositional density and relationships differ almost entirely.
